Taking off someone’s daily psychiatric medication is a breach of duty of care. Can you imagine your daily medication being taken away from you suddenly? Calling every single 111 line you can possibly imagine, taking days off work, experiencing withdrawal?

A GP should never endanger the life or health of a patient. Suddenly, ailsa Craig cares about the law and guidance they operate under. For 8 months, they have not while I’ve been in their care. Unacceptable behaviour from every single member of staff who allowed this to happen. My health had become a toy to play with daily apparently, at the mercy of a GP who cannot ask for a piece of paper in 8 months.

Be careful with every practice in Longsight and ardwick as they don’t prescribe it and likely won’t bother to involve the specialists needed on time.
